Hi {name},

Thank you for sharing a video about {action}. We read and watch everything people send, and this time we've decided not to put the video on the site.

It isn't about the good thing you did – that still counts, and it's still on your account. If you'd like, you're very welcome to share your story again in words or with a photo: {url}

Warmly,
Make Other People Happy
